_comment: Items this world can place. game_id is the MainManager.Items ordinal (enum starts at None = -1), and kind is where it goes: 0 = ordinary items, 1 = key items, 2 = medals (then game_id is the medal id, MainManager.BadgeTypes), 3 = berries (money; game_id is the amount), 4 = crystal berries (one item, game_id 0; the count is the currency; filler until the crystal berry shop is in the seed, then progression, since they buy locations there: the user, 2026-09-24). The Archipelago id is ITEM_ID_BASE + game_id, plus MEDAL_ID_OFFSET for a medal (medal ids overlap item ids) or MONEY_ID_OFFSET for berries. padding marks the filler used to fill leftover locations, in any number; every other item is in the pool once. Measured facts are in agent_docs/MEASURED.md.
